LightningComponentBundle.description: Custom action launcher that renders configured quick actions as pills, with search and an overflow dropdown.

property.name: actionApiNames
property.label: Quick Action API Names
property.description: Comma separated quick action API names in display order, for example Account.CreateOpportunity. Add new actions here instead of changing the component.

property.name: visibleActionCount
property.label: Actions Shown Before Overflow
property.description: Number of actions rendered as buttons. Any beyond this move into the dropdown.
